description: Weighted mingler: it fades between two input voltages across seven output jacks, each carrying a fixed mix of the two in steps of one sixth

inputs.text: One of the two voltages being mixed, all of output 1 and none of output 7; with nothing patched it reads a constant 6V
The other voltage, all of output 7 and none of output 1; with nothing patched it reads 0V

outputs.text: Carries the CV IN 1 voltage on its own
Five sixths of the CV IN 1 voltage added to one sixth of the CV IN 2 voltage
Two thirds of the CV IN 1 voltage added to one third of the CV IN 2 voltage
Half of the CV IN 1 voltage added to half of the CV IN 2 voltage
One third of the CV IN 1 voltage added to two thirds of the CV IN 2 voltage
One sixth of the CV IN 1 voltage added to five sixths of the CV IN 2 voltage
Carries the CV IN 2 voltage on its own

notes: this module has no controls at all: the proportion each output carries is fixed by the jack it comes from
with nothing patched the seven outputs carry a fixed ladder of 6V, 5V, 4V, 3V, 2V, 1V and 0V, because an unpatched CV IN 1 reads 6V and an unpatched CV IN 2 reads 0V
the lamp beside an output glows green for a positive voltage and red for a negative one, reaching full brightness at 10V

inputs.0:
continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 6V.
inputs.1:
